{{Top|mprot|leg}}
The '''SFS P-w702 maneuvering jet''' was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] as an upgrade to the [[P-w401 ion maneuvering jet/Legends|P-w401 ion maneuvering jet]]. It provided enhanced thrust propulsion to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] equipped with an [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]]. Two were used on [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighters.

[[Scythe Squadron/Legends|Scythe Squadron]], a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], was equipped with the upgraded maneuvering jets to improve flight performance within the tight confines of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].
